components.label: Integration partners
components.explanation: Submit independent reservation creates over HTTPS and retry ambiguous results with the same idempotency key. A burst may come from one partner, one owner, and one property.

components.label: Public HTTPS edge
components.explanation: Apply body and concurrency limits, and distribute requests to healthy API replicas. The demo accepts synthetic submissions without credentials.

components.label: Intake API
components.explanation: Validate the request, deduplicate by key and reservation identity, and commit a new intake and outbox entry together before returning 202. Read the current result by opaque intake ID. Return a retryable response during database failover or when backlog admission closes.

components.label: PostgreSQL
components.explanation: The Multi-AZ database is the durable record of accepted work. Different reservations need no owner-wide lock. An intake's outcome and its completed reservation are written atomically.

components.label: Outbox relay
components.explanation: Replicas claim outbox rows with expiring leases and publish independently. Mark an event sent only after SQS confirms it. Broker downtime leaves work in the outbox, and a crash after send can cause a duplicate.

components.label: SQS Standard
components.explanation: Buffer bursts and deliver different reservations in parallel without grouping them by owner or property. Visibility timeout supports redelivery and the receive limit routes unhandled messages to the dead-letter queue.

components.label: Reservation workers
components.explanation: A worker checks the dispatch generation, locks only the intake row, and commits the reservation and result together. Redeliveries for a completed or obsolete generation are safe. Retry transient failures using visibility delays.

components.label: Dead-letter queue
components.explanation: Retain repeatedly unhandled messages for recovery. The durable intake ledger remains available if a queue message or a dead letter has expired.

components.label: Recovery worker
components.explanation: Record a terminal failure for a matching pending generation from the DLQ. Flag overdue intakes from PostgreSQL. After an operator resolves the cause, replay the original payload via a fresh generation and outbox entry in the same transaction.

cards.title: One owner can use many workers
items: Each reservation is an independent unit of work, including reservations for the same property.
Scale from queue age and reserve database capacity for fresh intake during recovery.

cards.title: Acceptance survives broker downtime
items: The API confirms the PostgreSQL commit. The relay can publish later.
When the durable backlog reaches its threshold, return 503 and preserve accepted work.

cards.title: Recover from durable state
items: Worker retries can duplicate delivery. The database protects the reservation from duplicate creation.
A fresh dispatch generation permits replay even after broker retention expires.
